objective: Preallocate vector-index rebuild data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate vector rebuild data prefixes
tasks.result: Fusion storage vector-index rebuild scans now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in FusionStorage::rebuild_vector_index data scan prefix construction.
Generated prefix bytes, transaction scan prefixes, decoded row IDs, HNSW batches, and SQL HNSW query results are unchanged.
The focused helper test printed Cargo file-lock wait messages before passing.
